hypothesis: W-R13 pooled mismatch features carried information but the fixed perceptron likely underutilized small-magnitude signals. Scale the pooled mismatch by a factor learned strictly from development negatives, then test an entirely fresh, unseen heldout cohort and perturbation.
freeze: Freeze source, candidates, model width, epochs, scale rule, train/heldout splits, thresholds and negative outcomes before any first-use execution. No heldout-derived calibration or retraining.
generator: Same original Wingless 16-tick four-channel W-R11 synthetic formula; paired candidate applies a global +17 offset in training and +61 offset in heldout. Every negative preserves candidate's first row and multiset but reorders its 15-tick tail.
training_perturbation: Reversal of 15-tick tail on even-indexed entity, rotation left three on odd-indexed entity.
heldout_perturbation: Unseen rotation left seven on 15-tick tail; zero training examples use this rotation.
candidates: unscaled_pooled_mismatch: 16 repeated mean circular anchor-relative mismatch values
development_calibrated_pooled_mismatch: 16 repeated mismatch values normalized by strictly positive minimum mismatch across development negatives only, frozen before inference
learning: Identical 16-weight+bias perceptron, 32 epochs, learning rate 0.1 and zero init. Train-only scaling computed once per development cohort from negative inputs, never read heldout labels or scores.
primary: Per-seed confusion and balanced accuracy. TRAIN_CALIBRATED_TRANSFER if calibrated>=0.85 and histogram<=0.55; PARTIAL if calibrated>both baselines without achieving threshold; NEGATIVE otherwise. Preserve all failures.
validation: Data generation invariant asserts, exact 16 parameter-width for each candidate, no change in training examples or budgets, deterministic run() twice, one full repo regression, immutable SHA checks.
claim_limit: Frozen synthetic supervised feature calibration, no general language, real transfer, or accepted-ref change.
